record.paper_title: Exchange Bias and Interface-related Effects in Two-dimensional van der Waals Magnetic Heterostructures: Open Questions and Perspectives
record.original_question: Do the exchange-bias and quantum anomalous Hall effects predicted for CrI3/MnBi2Te4 ferromagnet/antiferromagnet heterostructures occur experimentally, and can analogous exchange-bias and quantum anomalous Hall phenomena be realized by interfacing MnBi2Te4 or related topological antiferromagnets with other van der Waals ferromagnets such as Fe3GeTe2 or Fe5GeTe2?

evidence.quote: These interesting predictions should be validated experimentally.

In this regard, it would also be interesting to interface MnBi2Te4 or similar [87] [88] with other types of vdW magnets such as Fe3GeTe2 or Fe5GeTe2, and further explore EB and QAH effects in those heterostructures.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Consider van der Waals magnetic heterostructures formed by stacking the layered antiferromagnetic magnetic topological insulator MnBi$_2$Te$_4$ with two-dimensional ferromagnetic materials. First-principles calculations for the ferromagnet/antiferromagnet heterostructure CrI$_3$/MnBi$_2$Te$_4$ predict (i) a sizable exchange-bias field at the interface, arising from hybridization between the Cr $e_g$ orbitals and Te $p$ orbitals, and (ii) the stabilization of out-of-plane surface magnetization that drives a zero-field quantum anomalous Hall (QAH) phase in MnBi$_2$Te$_4$ thin films.

Address the following:

(a) Can both the predicted exchange-bias effect and the predicted zero-field quantum anomalous Hall effect in CrI$_3$/MnBi$_2$Te$_4$ heterostructures be confirmed by direct experimental measurements (e.g., magnetotransport, magneto-optical Kerr effect)?

(b) Replacing CrI$_3$ with another two-dimensional ferromagnet such as Fe$_3$GeTe$_2$ or Fe$_5$GeTe$_2$ (or interfacing related intrinsic antiferromagnetic topological insulators in place of MnBi$_2$Te$_4$), can analogous exchange-bias phenomena and a QAH state be experimentally realized in such heterostructures, and characterize the magnitude of the exchange bias, its temperature dependence, and the conditions (thickness, gating, temperature) under which QAH transport emerges.
artifact.status_search_result: Exchange bias has been experimentally observed in MnBi2Te4-based van der Waals heterostructures, including a 2024 report of exchange bias in MnBi2Te4/Fe3GeTe2 (Applied Physics Letters) and intrinsic exchange-biased anomalous Hall effect within MnBi2Te4 itself (Nature Communications 2024). Theoretical CrI3/MnBi2Te4 predictions (Science Advances 2020) have motivated experiments, and exchange-biased QAH proposals continue to be explored (e.g., arXiv:2205.03596). However, an unambiguous experimental demonstration of the zero-field quantum anomalous Hall effect in CrI3/MnBi2Te4 or Fe(3,5)GeTe2/MnBi2Te4 heterostructures has not been clearly established, so the QAH portion of the question remains open while the exchange-bias portion is partially confirmed.

status_evidence.title: Exchange bias and quantum anomalous Hall effect in the MnBi2Te4/CrI3 heterostructure
status_evidence.snippet: Strong exchange bias ~40 meV; proposal for zero-field QAH in heterostructure.
status_evidence.claim: Theoretical prediction of EB and QAH in CrI3/MnBi2Te4.

status_evidence.title: Exchange bias in heterostructures combining MnBi2Te4 and Fe3GeTe2
status_evidence.snippet: Reports experimental exchange bias in MnBi2Te4/Fe3GeTe2 vdW heterostructure.
status_evidence.claim: Experimental EB realized with a different vdW ferromagnet.

status_evidence.title: Intrinsic exchange biased anomalous Hall effect in uncompensated antiferromagnet MnBi2Te4
status_evidence.snippet: Reports exchange-biased anomalous Hall effect intrinsic to MnBi2Te4.
status_evidence.claim: Exchange-bias-related AHE observed experimentally, but not zero-field QAH in CrI3 heterostructure.

status_evidence.title: Exchange-biased quantum anomalous Hall effect
status_evidence.snippet: Continued exploration of EB-stabilized QAH in magnetic topological insulators.
status_evidence.claim: QAH+EB combination still under active investigation.
